intent.desiredOutcome: Merchant receives daily low-stock alerts by email and can review report history and configure the stock threshold in the admin panel.

platformGaps.gap: No batch write API for inventory levels — each variant's inventory must be fetched individually if not available via bulk product endpoint
platformGaps.mitigation: Pre-fetch all product variants with their inventory quantities in bulk using the Admin REST API (products + variants with inventory_quantity) before the loop; per-item inventory reads are avoided by using the paginated variants bulk endpoint

platformGaps.gap: No single API endpoint returns all variants across all products with inventory levels in one call
platformGaps.mitigation: Use paginated Admin REST GET /admin/api/products.json with fields=id,variants and iterate pages before the loop begins (cronBatching); all data is resolved before threshold comparison logic runs

cronBatching.description: Before the loop begins, bulk-fetch all product variants with their inventory_quantity fields using paginated Admin REST API calls (GET /products.json?fields=id,title,variants&limit=250, paginating through all pages). This produces a complete in-memory list of variants with their current stock levels. The threshold comparison (inventory_quantity <= configured threshold) is then performed in-memory with no further Shopify API calls. This avoids per-item Shopify reads inside the loop.

columns.name: report_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES low_stock_reports(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

cronContract.handlerMustProduce: For each cron run: (1) Read the tenant's configured stock_threshold from low_stock_settings (default 10 if no row exists). (2) Bulk-fetch all product variants with inventory_quantity from Shopify Admin REST API via paginated requests before entering the comparison loop. (3) Filter variants where inventory_quantity is less than or equal to the threshold — this numeric comparison is performed directly in the handler with no state machine. (4) Insert one low_stock_reports row recording ran_at, threshold_used, total_variants_checked, and low_stock_count. (5) Insert one low_stock_report_items row per low-stock variant capturing product_id, product_title, variant_id, variant_title, and inventory_quantity. (6) If at least one low-stock variant exists, send a transactional email to the merchant summarising the low-stock items and mark email_sent = true on the report row. If no variants are below threshold, still insert the report row with email_sent = false and skip the email.
